Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T03:42Z · On the seat's decision card 「头像菜单的语言要不要和登录页一样列全部 11 种?」 (should the avatar menu list all 11 interface languages, like the sign-in page?), the maintainer chose 「两处都列全部 11 种」 (option A of three) at 2026-11-21T03:39:49Z. The other two options were 「两处都按应用语言收窄」 (narrow both to the app's declared languages) and 「清单不变,只补当前语言」 (keep both lists, only add the current language to the menu).

Recorded meaning (the card's "要做的" item 1; item 2 is dropped):
- The sign-in page and the avatar menu offer the same list: every interface language the console ships (the platform locale table, 11 today).
- A language the app has no translation for stays selectable. The interface chrome shows in that language; business objects, field names and views fall back to the deployment's default language. The menu marks such languages with one short line, 「应用内容显示为默认语言」 (wording may be polished, but it says "default language", not "English").
- A language picked on the sign-in page is found, checked and selectable again in the menu after sign-in.
- Frontend only: `/api/v1/i18n/locales` is unchanged and no language pack is added. The profile page's language card uses the same list; the organisation default-language setting keeps the app's declared list.
- This loosens the 2026-11-02 ruling F on #29349 (one tier, no menu hint) that #30514 implemented. The menu hint F rejected is now wanted.

The work goes to area b1-CX; the PR carries `Fixes #35425`.
